intro: Cleansing the Eye is an Alliance quest that sends adventurers from the murky Wetlands south to the human capital of Stormwind. After recovering the cursed scrying stone known as the Eye of Paleth, travelers must seek the aid of Archbishop Benedictus to purge its lingering taint.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you. Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. He can help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.

clips.title: Completion
paras: An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.
Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
